notes.title: Level design is in action!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=flrt1evaruY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Level design is in action!

We are currently working on level design in the game. It takes a long time because every little thing matters. It is not only what surrounds the player, but also details that help to make the design coherent.

For example, what you see on sketches is just the designer's sketches. Further, it adapts to the logic of the game, how you need to go through the levels. Not just an object that comes across you on the way, it should be interesting, have its own role within the gameplay.

We do not miss the opportunity to immerse you in the process of creating a game! Show not only the result, but also tell how we achieved it.

notes.title: Get the key to the game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305006/50cc9d9e7ddddfefe45a85a077f3ee8dac882256.jpg[/img]
The new VR game Westernlands: Girly runways story is coming soon!
We decided to give the key to everyone who can prank a student in our Bad Boy Simulator!

Conditions:
1. Start the BBS game
2. Implement a prank on a student that is tearing him up
3. Make a screen
4. Attach the screen in the discussion to this post

On June 15, we will check each participant and give a key to get into the atmosphere of the Wild West in the new VR game Westernlands: Girly runways story!
Ready? Then let's start!

notes.title: Game creation process
notes.content:
In the process of character development, we pay great attention to realism. The character should not only reflect the atmosphere of the game, but also immerse the player in virtual reality. You are immersed in another space, where your rules and players.

That is why we focus on the little things. Details in the costumes, accessories of the hero, his emotions. In the game Westerlands, our task is to plunge you into the world of the Wild West, to make you feel the race through the desert and the city, to feel next to your companion, with whom you are going to jailbreak together.

At the moment, we have already completed the 3D models of the characters and are finalizing their appearance. Designers draw locations, a bonus part and the necessary little things.

The work is in full swing, join the community so as not to miss information!

notes.title: Hey! We begin!
notes.content:
Hey! We are in the process of developing characters that will accompany you throughout the game!

We solve the issue of clothes, colors and details that will plunge everyone into the wild west. Be warned, no one has ever seen such a wild west! Escaping from prison is not only risky, but also exciting!

Subscribe! We begin to immerse you in the game Westerlands: Girly runways story.
